review_note: Each transcribed ability below was checked against the named original PNG screenshots. The screenshots show a historical game state; current release status is not independently established.

abilities.name: Claw Swipe II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Viserion strikes all enemies for 250% ATK Physical Damage and removes all BIRTHRIGHT, FURY and ENRAGED from them. Viserion deals 100% ATK Physical Damage for each Buff he removed.

abilities.name: Own Pace
abilities.exact_visible_text: Viserion strikes an enemy for 200% ATK Physical Damage and then PACIFIES himself for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Rude Awakening II
abilities.exact_visible_text: If Viserion is struck while sleeping, if he is not BRITTLE, he will strike all enemies for 400% ATK Fire Damage and his patience meter fills by 25%. Viserion begins combat with full Stamina, and he will destroy all SHIELDS and refill his Stamina every time he wakes.

abilities.name: Golden Scales
abilities.exact_visible_text: Viserion loses 7% DEF and DURABILITY for 2 turns for every RAID applied to him. If the RAID was applied by a Skill, all allies gain 30% Stamina.

abilities.name: Patience II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Viserion has a patience meter. It fills 3% at the start of each turn. When filled, Viserion strikes all enemies for 100% HP Pool True Damage. When afflicted with ICE, Viserion takes 3% Max HP True Damage. Anytime an enemy REINFORCES the battle, Viserion's patience meter fills an additional 10% and he will strike the REINFORCING enemy for 100% HP Pool True Damage.

abilities.name: Unchained Dragon
abilities.exact_visible_text: Viserion is immune to FIRE and POISON. All champions begin combat with a -50% Gem Damage debuff. Viserion will remove STUN and DECEIVE from himself at the start of the turn, if he removes one of these debuffs, his patience doubles.

abilities.name: Dracarys
abilities.exact_visible_text: Drogon strikes an enemy, dealing 250% ATK Fire Damage to them and WOUNDING them for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Aegis Bane
abilities.exact_visible_text: Drogon strikes an enemy, dealing 100% ATK Fire Damage.

abilities.name: Ember Storm II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Any time a power-up gem is matched or destroyed, Drogon strikes all enemies for 50% ATK Fire Damage and reduces the enemy TREASURY by 1. All player champions have their Gem Damage reduced by -75%.

abilities.name: Born in Flames II
abilities.exact_visible_text: Drogon is immune to: STUN, DECEIVE, PACIFY, FIRE, RAID, POISON, and ICE. At the start of the turn, if no champions used their SKILL in the previous turn, Drogon has a 50% chance to afflict all enemies with 1 FIRE.

abilities.name: Daznak's Fury
abilities.exact_visible_text: At the start of each turn, allies with BIRTHRIGHT deal 5% of Drogon's HP to him. Free Cities allies gain an indefinite 10% ATK buff and recover 30% Stamina after using their skill.

abilities.name: Brimstone Rain II
abilities.exact_visible_text: At the start of each turn, if no player champions used their SKILLS during the previous turn, Drogon will strike all enemies for 10% ATK Fire Damage. This attack deals an additional 15% ATK Fire Damage every time it triggers.
